nodes.text:
Government Assures No Cause for Alarm Over HMPV
The Ministry of Health has reassured the public regarding the Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) outbreak in China, stating there is no need for concern. https://t.co/AYUyUGJYRw

nodes.author: neonmantweets__
nodes.text:
Dr. Atul Goel, Director-General of Health Services, explained that HMPV is similar to common respiratory viruses, typically causing mild cold or flu-like symptoms, particularly in young children or the elderly.

.

nodes.author: neonmantweets__
nodes.text: The Union Health Ministry confirmed that affected families have no recent travel history. It is closely monitoring the global situation of HMPV to ensure public safety
